{"sample_id":"arvo_19338",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":55,"var":"data","code":"otPlatRadioReceiveDone(instance, &frame, OT_ERROR_NONE)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Fuzzer-supplied bytes are delivered as a radio frame to the OpenThread stack"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"HandleChildUpdateRequest",
    "line":2250,"var":"challenge","code":"Tlv::GetTlv(aMessage, Tlv::kChallenge, sizeof(challenge), challenge)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Challenge TLV is read from message into stack-allocated ChallengeTlv (8-byte mChallenge buffer); only sizeof(ChallengeTlv)=10 bytes copied but length field retains attacker value 11"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"HandleChildUpdateRequest",
    "line":2270,"var":"challenge","code":"SendChildUpdateResponse(NULL, aMessageInfo, tlvs, tlvslength, challenge)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Challenge with uncapped length=11 passed to SendChildUpdateResponse when child is NULL and mode is RxOnWhenIdle"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"SendChildUpdateResponse",
    "line":3011,"var":"aChallenge.GetLength()","code":"AppendResponse(*message, aChallenge.GetChallenge(), aChallenge.GetLength())",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Uses raw GetLength() (returns 11) instead of GetChallengeLength() (capped at 8), passing 11 as size to AppendResponse from an 8-byte buffer"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"AppendResponse",
    "line":1189,"var":"aResponseLength","code":"aMessage.Append(aResponse, aResponseLength)",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Appends 11 bytes from the 8-byte mChallenge buffer causing a 3-byte stack-buffer-overflow READ"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":55,"operands":["data","frame.mLength"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"SendChildUpdateResponse",
     "line":3011,"operands":["aChallenge.GetLength()","ChallengeTlv::kMaxSize"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"aChallenge.GetLength()","right":"ChallengeTlv::kMaxSize"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"AppendResponse",
     "line":1189,"operands":["aResponse","aResponseLength"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"aResponseLength","right":"sizeof(mChallenge)"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"tests/fuzz/radio_receive_done.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":55,"operands":["data"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"HandleChildUpdateRequest",
       "line":2250,"operands":["challenge"]},
      "type":"data","via":["otPlatRadioReceiveDone","Tlv::GetTlv"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"HandleChildUpdateRequest",
       "line":2250,"operands":["challenge"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"SendChildUpdateResponse",
       "line":3011,"operands":["aChallenge.GetLength()"]},
      "type":"data","via":["challenge"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle_router.cpp","function":"SendChildUpdateResponse",
       "line":3011,"operands":["aChallenge.GetLength()"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"AppendResponse",
       "line":1189,"operands":["aResponseLength"]},
      "type":"data","via":["aChallenge.GetLength()"]}
   ]
 }}
